text.keybindsgalore.press_any_key: Press any key or click any mouse button...
text.keybindsgalore.capture_instruction: Press a key to see its conflicts and set a priority.
option.keybindsgalore.debug.tooltip: Logs every keypress and prioritization check to the console. Produces huge log output!
option.keybindsgalore.verbose_debug.tool: Logs even more detailed debug information, including conflict resolution internals.
option.keybindsgalore.lazy_conflict_chec: Only checks key conflicts when a key changes rather than every tick. Reduces overhead.
option.keybindsgalore.circle_vertices.to: Number of vertices used to render the pie menu circle. Higher values look smoother but use more performance. Range: 6-360.
option.keybindsgalore.pulse_timer_durati: How long the key pulse visualisation lasts in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Range: 0-200.
option.keybindsgalore.use_keybind_fix.to: Applies a fix for vanilla keybind behaviour in certain scenarios. Disable only if it causes issues.
option.keybindsgalore.enable_attack_work: Workaround for the vanilla attack key holding behaviour. Keeps attack consistent during priority changes.
Enables the circular pie menu for keybind selection instead of the default list.
option.keybindsgalore.show_conflict_warn: Shows a warning in chat when key conflicts are detected.
option.keybindsgalore.filtered_categorie: Key categories to exclude from conflict detection. Matches a category label or id exactly, ignoring case. The 26.2 labels are: Creative Mode, Gameplay, Inventory, Miscellaneous, Movement, Multiplayer, Spectator, Game Interface. Leave empty to check every category.
option.keybindsgalore.priority_categorie: Entire key categories whose bindings take priority when conflicts occur (e.g. 'Movement').
Specific keybind-action pairs that always win conflicts. Format: actionID:keyName (e.g. key.jump:key.keyboard.space).
option.keybindsgalore.ignored_keys.toolt: GLFW key codes to skip during conflict detection. Useful for keys that are frequently rebound.
option.keybindsgalore.invert_ignored_key: When enabled, the ignored keys list becomes an allowed list - only those keys will be checked for conflicts.
option.keybindsgalore.expansion_factor_w: How far the hovered sector grows outward from the pie, as a fraction of the pie radius. 0.06 is a subtle default. Range: 0.0-0.3.
option.keybindsgalore.pie_menu_margin.to: Empty space between the pie menu and the screen edge, in pixels. Larger values shrink the available space. Range: 0-200.
option.keybindsgalore.pie_scale.tooltip: Pie radius as a fraction of half the shorter screen dimension, after the margin. 0.8 is the default. Range: 0.1-1.0.
Radius of the central cancel zone as a fraction of the pie radius. Releasing the key while the cursor is inside cancels the selection. 0.2 is the default. Range: 0.05-0.9.
option.keybindsgalore.darkened_backgroun: Darkens the screen behind whichever selector is open. Applies to both the pie menu and the list menu.
How strongly the pie menu background is darkened, from 0 (no darkening) to 255 (solid black). The list menu has its own fixed dimming and ignores this. Only applies while Darken Background is on.
option.keybindsgalore.pie_menu_blend.too: Not implemented yet. The setting is saved but currently has no effect.
Renders a shadow behind action labels in the pie menu for improved readability.
option.keybindsgalore.use_software_rende: Legacy option with no effect on this version. The pie menu always renders on the GPU. Kept so older config files still load.
option.keybindsgalore.sector_gradation.t: Not implemented yet. The setting is saved but currently has no effect.
option.keybindsgalore.animate_pie_menu.t: Not implemented yet. The setting is saved but currently has no effect.
option.keybindsgalore.color.tooltip: Background colour behind the list menu rows. This affects the list menu only, not the pie menu.
option.keybindsgalore.color_select.toolt: Colour used when a pie menu sector is selected.
option.keybindsgalore.color_highlight.to: Highlight colour for the list menu row under the cursor. This affects the list menu only, not the pie menu.
option.keybindsgalore.color_even.tooltip: Colour for even-numbered pie menu sectors. Enter an ARGB hex value such as C0606060, or use the colour preview to pick one.
option.keybindsgalore.color_odd.tooltip: Colour for odd-numbered pie menu sectors.
option.keybindsgalore.color_selected.too: Colour of the currently selected pie menu sector.
option.keybindsgalore.color_last_odd.too: Colour for the last odd-numbered sector (used when the sector count is uneven).
option.keybindsgalore.color_cancel.toolt: Colour of the cancel zone at the centre of the pie menu.
option.keybindsgalore.color_cancel_hover: Colour of the cancel zone when the mouse hovers over it.
option.keybindsgalore.color_lighten_fact: RGB value added to alternating sector colours so odd wedges stand out from even ones. Range: 0-16777215.
option.keybindsgalore.pie_menu_alpha.too: Opacity of the list menu, from 0 (invisible) to 255 (solid). This affects the list menu only, not the pie menu.
